Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest Under the Municipal Conflict of Interest
Extension of Draft Plan Approval, Draft Plan of Subdivision 23T-16003
notes: Report from B. Salmon, Managing Director of Planning & Development B. Salmon, Managing Director of Planning & Development provided an overview of the report and background information on the subdivision approval. He noted the draft plan of subdivision 23T-16003 was approved by the Local Planning Appeal Tribunal, now known as the Ontario Land Tribunal. The draft approval was granted because of a settlement between the applicant, the Township of Centre Wellington, and the County of Wellington. It is the County's standard practice to include a lapsing provision in the conditions of approvals, usually five years from the date the draft approval is granted.

B. Salmon indicated the draft plan approval will lapse after October 9, 2024, and due to an oversight, a special meeting of council was required to avoid the need for the applicant to re-apply for draft plan approval at considerable time and expense.
B. Salmon responded to questions regarding alignment with the density target and the timing of the special meeting.

items.title: A By-law to confirm the actions of Council

motions.item_title: Extension of Draft Plan Approval, Draft Plan of Subdivision 23T-16003
motions.text: THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington supports a three-year extension to the draft plan approval of Plan 23T-16003 (Storybrook West); AND THAT a copy of this resolution and Staff Report PLN2024-37 be forwarded to the approval authority (County of Wellington).
